summary: ZenaTech, Inc. (Nasdaq/FSE/BMV: ZENA), a Vancouver-based AI drone and enterprise SaaS provider, announced via Form 6-K on September 9, 2026 the completed acquisition of ESM Software, a Boston-based strategy execution and performance management software firm operating since 1998 with more than 8,000 users across government, healthcare, utilities, financial services and retail. The filing discloses no purchase price, consideration mix, premium or close date beyond completion. No board recommendation or advisor is named. ESM becomes the 13th SaaS brand and will integrate into ZenaTech's beta-stage Zoo Office platform. Risk-arb angle: economically immaterial without deal terms; watch for 8-K/20-F disclosure of price and financing.
